title: New Parent Support
intro: New Parent Support Program is a family-focused service designed for active-duty personnel and their families who are expecting a child or have children age five and under. It promotes healthy development and confident parenting by offering home visits, education, and ongoing support.

sections.heading: Home Visits
sections.markdown:
Home visits can take place in the home, the New Parent Support office or any other convenient and comfortable location within a 50 mile radius. The evidence based Parents as Teachers curriculum is utilized during home visits for military families who are expecting or who have children ages five and under.

[I'm Interested](https://eventactions.com/eareg.aspx?ea=Rsvp&invite=0pe9z1vkp0cth133tc4frt3hcvxh629kb1ejtbtmrwb24hhj845x)

sections.heading: Infant Massage
sections.markdown: Infant massage is a wonderful opportunity to spend quality, focused time with your infant. It is a great way for fathers to get involved and best of all, it's FUN & FREE! This class is designed for babies (6 weeks to 6 months) and up to 2 caregivers. See schedule below for our 5-week training. Requests for 1:1 training may be made through Home Visits.

sections.heading: Baby Boot Camp
sections.markdown: This is a fun and interactive class for expectant parents or those who have children up to 3 months of age. Baby Boot Camp participants will gain knowledge that will help them feel more confident in caring for their new baby. Helpful local family resources are also discussed.
